blueprintwand.cmd.no_selection: Select an area with the wand first: left click - point 1, right click - point 2.
blueprintwand.cmd.other_dimension: The selection was made in another dimension.
blueprintwand.cmd.not_found: File not found: %s. Use /schem list to see saved schematics.
blueprintwand.cmd.corrupt: Corrupted file: size / layers / palette is missing or invalid.
blueprintwand.cmd.paste_too_big: Schematic is empty or too large (max %s blocks).
blueprintwand.cmd.corrupt_rows: Corrupted file: layer %s has %s rows instead of %s.
blueprintwand.cmd.corrupt_len: Corrupted file: layer %s, row %s has length %s instead of %s.
blueprintwand.cmd.pasted: Pasted "%s" at %s %s %s (%s×%s×%s), blocks changed: %s. Undo: /schem undo
blueprintwand.cmd.undone: Undone, blocks restored: %s (chest contents and other block data are not restored).
blueprintwand.cmd.preview: Preview "%s" at %s %s %s (%s×%s×%s). /schem confirm to paste, /schem cancel to cancel. Run /schem preview again to move or rotate.
blueprintwand.cmd.no_preview: No active preview. Use /schem preview <name> first.
blueprintwand.cmd.preview_dimension: The preview was made in another dimension.
blueprintwand.tooltip.list: Right click - browse saved schematics and paste them
blueprintwand.gui.title: Saved schematics
blueprintwand.gui.empty: No schematics yet. Select an area with the wand and use /schem save <name>.
blueprintwand.gui.none: Select a schematic from the list
blueprintwand.gui.status_preview: Preview active - press Place to build it
blueprintwand.gui.howto1: 1. Pick a schematic, rotation and position, then press Preview - a translucent copy of the build and a yellow frame appear.
blueprintwand.gui.howto2: 2. Open this list again and press Place to build it (or type /schem confirm).
blueprintwand.gui.howto3: Cancel removes the frame, Undo reverts the last paste. Operator rights are required.
blueprintwand.cmd.preview_no_ghost: The schematic has more than %s blocks, so only the frame is shown (no translucent blocks).
